headline_marked: Hasan Mahmud's 6-for: [[Bangladesh bowl out Australia for 198]] in Darwin
headline: Hasan Mahmud's 6-for: Bangladesh bowl out Australia for 198 in Darwin
summary: Hasan Mahmud claims a career-best 6/55, becoming the first Bangladeshi to take a Test five-wicket haul in Australia.
details: Bangladesh dominated the opening day of the first Test against Australia at Marrara Stadium in Darwin, bowling out the hosts for 198.
Hasan Mahmud led the attack with a career-best 6 for 55, making him the first Bangladeshi bowler to ever claim a Test five-wicket haul on Australian soil.
Steve Smith was the only significant threat to the Tigers' pacers, scoring 71 runs before being dismissed by Hasan Mahmud.
In a post-match press conference, Smith admitted he had nicked a delivery from Ebadot Hossain early in his innings but was saved by the Real Time Snicko technology.
Despite the early scare and a dropped catch by Tanzid Tamim, Smith managed to notch his 45th Test fifty.

The Tigers' fast-bowling display has earned them widespread praise for their consistency and precision throughout the first day.
caption:
A historic day for the Tigers! Hasan Mahmud takes 6 wickets to dismantle Australia in Darwin.

Bangladesh dominated the opening day of the first Test against Australia at Marrara Stadium in Darwin, bowling out the hosts for 198.

Hasan Mahmud led the attack with a career-best 6 for 55, making him the first Bangladeshi bowler to ever claim a Test five-wicket haul on Australian soil.

Steve Smith was the only significant threat to the Tigers' pacers, scoring 71 runs before being dismissed by Hasan Mahmud.

In a post-match press conference, Smith admitted he had nicked a delivery from Ebadot Hossain early in his innings but was saved by the Real Time Snicko technology.

Despite the early scare and a dropped catch by Tanzid Tamim, Smith managed to notch his 45th Test fifty.

At stumps on day one, Bangladesh were comfortably in control at 96 for one, trailing by 102 runs with nine wickets in hand.

The Tigers' fast-bowling display has earned them widespread praise for their consistency and precision throughout the first day.

headline_marked: BNP nominates [[Mirza Fakhrul as presidential candidate]] for 23rd election
headline: BNP nominates Mirza Fakhrul as presidential candidate for 23rd election
summary: The party has submitted his nomination papers to the Election Commission; Fakhrul has resigned from his party posts to contest the race.
details: The Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) has officially nominated Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir as its candidate for the 23rd presidential election.
A party delegation submitted his nomination papers to Chief Election Commissioner AMM Nasir Uddin at the CEC's office in Agargaon, Dhaka, this afternoon.
The nomination was announced by BNP Chairman Tarique Rahman during a high-level party meeting held at the Cabinet Division conference room of the secretariat.
Following the nomination, Mirza Fakhrul has resigned from his positions as the party's Secretary General and member of its Standing Committee.
Fakhrul is currently the Member of Parliament for the Thakurgaon-2 constituency and serves as the LGRD minister in the BNP-led government.
BNP Standing Committee member Moyeen Khan acted as the proposer and Gayeshwar Chandra Roy as the seconder for the nomination paper.
caption:
BNP has officially entered the presidential race with Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir.

The Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) has officially nominated Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir as its candidate for the 23rd presidential election.

A party delegation submitted his nomination papers to Chief Election Commissioner AMM Nasir Uddin at the CEC's office in Agargaon, Dhaka, this afternoon.

The nomination was announced by BNP Chairman Tarique Rahman during a high-level party meeting held at the Cabinet Division conference room of the secretariat.

Following the nomination, Mirza Fakhrul has resigned from his positions as the party's Secretary General and member of its Standing Committee.

Fakhrul is currently the Member of Parliament for the Thakurgaon-2 constituency and serves as the LGRD minister in the BNP-led government.

BNP Standing Committee member Moyeen Khan acted as the proposer and Gayeshwar Chandra Roy as the seconder for the nomination paper.
